'''Shellaster''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] who worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Assigned to the [[Riverfall Wilds]], he was visited by a group of spacers who wanted new uniforms, but he sent them to the nearby camp run by [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Nashal (individual)|Nashal]]&mdash;not realizing they were [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] spies.<ref name="Into the Maw" />
